select tv.id,tv.enterprise_name,tv.social_credit_code,tvc.contact_name,tvc.contact_phone,tv.registered_capital, concat(tv.enterprise_province_name,'-',tv.enterprise_city_name) as vendor_address,tar.total_amount_inc_tax,tvpr.tvp_excellent_num from tb_vendor tv left join tb_vendor_contact tvc on tv.id = tvc.vendor_id and tvc.is_main_contact = 1 left join ( select ta.vendor_id as ta_vendor_id ,sum(ta.total_amount_inc_tax) as total_amount_inc_tax from tb_agreement ta group by ta.vendor_id ) tar on tar.ta_vendor_id = tv.id left join ( select tvp.vendor_id as tvp_vendor_id,sum(tvp.excellent_num) as tvp_excellent_num from tb_vendor_performance_evaluation tvp group by tvp.vendor_id ) tvpr on tvpr.tvp_vendor_id = tv.id
tv.enterprise_name like concat('%',#{queryVO.enterpriseName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
and tvc.contact_name like concat('%',#{queryVO.contactName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
and tvc.contact_phone like concat('%',#{queryVO.contactPhone,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
order by tar.total_amount_inc_tax desc,tvpr.tvp_excellent_num desc

select ta.party_a_name,ta.agreement_name,ta.agreement_sign_date,tv.enterprise_name from tb_agreement ta left join tb_vendor tv on tv.id = ta.vendor_id where ta.vendor_id = #{queryVO.vendorId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
